主要内容: The Walt Disney Company and Robert A. Iger entered into an amendment to Mr. Iger's employment agreement. The amendment reduces by $13,500,000 the annual total compensation opportunities that the Company would have made available to Mr. Iger upon the closing of the transaction contemplated by the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated December 13, 2017. The changes include eliminating the annual base salary increase of $500,000, maintaining annual base salary at $3,000,000; eliminating the annualized $8,000,000 increase in Mr. Iger's annual target bonus opportunity, maintaining it at $12,000,000; and decreasing the annual target long-term incentive award opportunity by $5,000,000 to $20,000,000. The amendment also maintains the terms and conditions of long-term performance awards as applicable to the 2017 fiscal year awards.
